xrp_insights.methodology: Issuer-reported holdings scraped from each fund issuer's own website; daily flow computed as day-over-day change in reported XRP holdings; no third-party flow feed for current data.
limitations: GXRP flow is withheld because issuer-site capture was blocked from 2026-09-02 through 2026-09-28; its holdings remain in totals.
BITW is a multi-asset index fund; XRP holdings can move with index rebalancing.
Holdings changes can arise from causes other than creations/redemptions, including BITW rebalancing and XRP-paid fee accruals.
Some historical rows are reconstructed from third-party daily flow estimates between issuer-reported anchor days.
Commercial redistribution of the underlying dataset requires written permission; only normalized excerpts are retained here.
Nov 6 is explicitly partial (3 of 4), not a completed four-fund total.
The 9 Nov issuer-file label paired with a 7 Nov read time is chronologically impossible and is not used as a trusted publication timestamp.
GXRP is not collected daily because of automated-read blocking; XRPR is excluded because direct holdings do not represent its full exposure through another ETP.
Underlying issuer files overlap XRP Insights' sources, so the two scrapers are not independent confirmations at the issuer-data level.

methodology_notes: Alpha Finance says the ETF dashboard feed is CoinGlass.
The methodology says issuer reports can arrive a day late and sessions with no reports are omitted rather than treated as zero.
The XRP dashboard nevertheless displays $0 across 5 of 5 funds for the Nov 6 session.
The page does not publish XRP fund AUM or holdings in its XRP flow table.

reconciliation.direct_observation: Two issuer-page-based aggregators report a Nov 6 XRP outflow: XRP Insights reports -663,043 XRP across its broader six-spot-plus-BITW dataset (GXRP flow excluded); CryptoKeyhole reports a partial -752,048 XRP from XRPC with 3 of 4 tracked funds published. Alpha Finance's CoinGlass-fed dashboard reports $0 across five funds for the same Nov 6 session.
why_the_numbers_are_not_comparable: Fund universes differ: XRP Insights tracks six spot products plus BITW; CryptoKeyhole tracks four daily files and had only three for Nov 6; Alpha Finance lists five funds and excludes XRPR and BITW.
XRP Insights computes holdings deltas from issuer pages; Alpha Finance uses CoinGlass and may reflect a different flow definition or feed vintage.
Holdings deltas can include fee sales, index rebalancing and corrections; they are not a pure measure of primary-market cash subscriptions/redemptions.
CryptoKeyhole's Nov 6 observation is partial and its future-dated issuer-file label is quarantined.
competing_hypotheses: Alpha Finance's CoinGlass feed was stale or normalized the issuer holdings change differently, producing a zero session despite the issuer-page-derived XRPC decrease.
The -752,048 XRP XRPC holdings delta contains a non-creation/redemption component or issuer correction, while the CoinGlass series reflects cash creations/redemptions only.
The fund-universe differences and missing XRPZ file account for part of the -89,005 XRP gap between the two holdings-delta aggregators.
One or more third-party dashboards has a parsing, timing or source-vintage error.
disconfirming_evidence: XRP Insights metadata explicitly says current flows are calculated from issuer-reported holdings and not a third-party flow feed.
CryptoKeyhole independently scrapes overlapping issuer pages and reports the same large XRPC outflow, but this is not independent at the underlying issuer-source level.

Alpha Finance says all five funds reported the latest session; its own methodology says missing sessions should be omitted, so its displayed zero is an affirmative provider result rather than a documented missing value.
The CryptoKeyhole future-date label is internally inconsistent, weakening confidence in its timestamp metadata but not by itself disproving the reported holdings row.

source_independence.xrp_insights: Independent scraper and own holdings-delta calculation, but issuer source pages overlap CryptoKeyhole.
source_independence.cryptokeyhole: Independent scraper and calculation over overlapping issuer pages; not independent of XRP Insights at the underlying issuer-data layer.
source_independence.alpha_finance: CoinGlass commercial API upstream; do not count as independent from CoinGlass-derived dashboards.

model_admission.permitted_future_feature: separately named, vintage-stamped issuer_holdings_delta_proxy with fund-universe and capture-gap flags
model_admission.prohibited_inference: Do not call this actual capital, net cash subscriptions, or verified XRP purchases without issuer creation/redemption units and reconciled fund-level holdings.
